title: Benchmarking Synthetic Tabular Data Generators for Structural Coherence of Behavioral and Educational Datasets
summary: A Victoria University of Wellington summer scholarship project benchmarking LLM-based, diffusion-based, and classical synthetic tabular data generators for their ability to preserve SEM structural coherence in PISA 2022 and TIMSS 2023 educational/behavioral datasets. SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and CTGANSynthesizer (sdv.single_table) are fit and evaluated as baseline generators alongside diffusion and LLM-based methods.
